sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam.
Morning debrief with Night Shift completed; standing by to charge the Ops Phone, sitting at 20% — too low for a whole shift deployment.
Ops Phone at 45% — good enough for shift routes and patrols.
Commencing Alpha Route. Check-in at corner of Victoria Street East and Queen Street, all clear; construction on the footpath still ongoing.

Standing by to show presence to morning commuters arriving into the CBD via the bus stops on Wellesley Street West, Te Waihorotiu train station and the Queen Street bus stop along the main strip next to the Civic and Aotea Square. Funnelled morning foot traffic medium to light.
Check-in at Skyworld Entertainment Centre and Aotea Square, all clear.
Walkthrough of the Bledisloe Building alleyway behind Skyworld Entertainment Centre, all clear.
Welfare check at Te Waihorotiu train station, all clear.
Welfare check on stores along Wellesley Street West, all clear:
Tony's Original Steakhouse and Seafood Restaurant
EIKBEN by Mark'ne Limited Wellesley Street West
Welfare check at Elliott Stables, Elliott Street Apartment, Atrium on Elliott, Elliott Food Court, all clear.
Standing by to show presence at Elliott Street before moving to the next checkpoint.
While on standby, received a response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a female individual sleeping in-store; assistance requested to move her along.

Arrived at the response call and asked her to leave, and she complied. On leaving she explained it was a misunderstanding — she was just a little tired and sleepy — and that she would order a meal. Staff agreed, as long as she understood that sleeping in-store is not allowed.
Standing by at McDonald's to show presence while awaiting response calls and incidents.
Leaving standby and recommencing Alpha Route. Welfare check, all clear:
Welfare check at Albert Mart Convenience Store, Discount Dairy and Vape Shop, Nola Coffee, Ichiiban Japanese Restaurant, Round Six, JW Marriott, all clear.
Welfare check and walkthrough of Wheirko Lane, Commercial Bay, all clear.
Check-in at Commercial Bay, full sweep around the square, all clear.
77 Convenience Store corner of Commerce and Quay Street
Standing by to show presence to morning commuters and the public before moving to the next checkpoint.
Ending Alpha Route and commencing Delta Route. Check-in at Commercial Bay, all clear.
Dilworth Building entrance Customs Street East
Mistry Shoe Repair and Key Cutting
Welfare check and walkthrough of Fort Lane, all clear:
Imperial Lane entrance through Fort Lane
Check-in at corner of Fort Street and Fort Lane, all clear.
Welfare check, all clear, including a quick sweep of Wilson Carpark Fort Street:
Welfare check at Hoka, UGG Shoes, Haven Mart, North Face, Taco Bell, Shortland Street Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check on lower High Street towards Lorne Street, all clear:
Check-in at corner of Wellesley Street East and Lorne Street, all clear.
Welfare check at Bentto, Choice Plaza, Sushiya, Choice Backpackers, Little Hanoi, Little Panda Takeaway Wellesley Street East, all clear.
Check-in at corner of Rutland Street and Wakefield Street, all clear.
Queens Food Court and all restaurants within the vicinity
Tanuki Japanese Sake and Sushi Bar
Check-in at Auckland Town Hall, all clear.

Check-in at Skyworld Entertainment Centre and Aotea Square; welfare check at Jack's Fried Chicken, Jack's Cafeteria, The Terrace, Aotea Centre, Cafe and Bar, all clear. Ending Delta Route here and commencing Echo Route.
Check-in at corner of Darby Street and Queen Street, all clear.
Welfare check at Lumi Cafe, Celine Mediterranean Cuisine, Mali Thai, Recycle Boutique, Pizza Club Elliott Street (under renovation), all clear.
Welfare check at Mecca, Dangerfield, the new Ippondo branch next to Dangerfield, Lush, the old NZ Muscles premises, 2degrees, all clear.
Welfare check on stores along the Durham Street East alleyway, all clear:
Welfare check on businesses within the Durham Street West alleyway vicinity, all clear:
New EIKBEN by Mark'ne Limited branch opening soon next to TechPro
Welfare check of Vulcan Lane and businesses within the vicinity, all clear:
Check-in at corner of Shortland Street and Queen Street, all clear.
Check-in at Queens Arcade (still under renovation), all clear.
Ending Echo Route and commencing Beta Route.
Welfare check at Coffee Club corner of Commerce and Customs Street East, 77 Convenience Store, Mr Katsu, Javalab Cafe, Harbour Society, all clear.
Check-in at corner of Gore Street and Customs Street, all clear.
Lunch break completed; standing by for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.
Response message from a jewellery shop on High Street asking us to keep an eye out for a suspicious individual on the road.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam.
Maintaining presence on Queen Street for any nearby response calls and any problematic issues that may occur within the area.
Footlocker staff asked for our presence due to a male who appears to be intoxicated entering their store; standing by.
The male has left the premises but is still within the area; continuing standby in case response calls come in about the POI.
Leaving standby area, no further sighting of the male from Footlocker; heading down to TK Square.
Arrived outside Hallensteins Queen Street; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear, no issues. Standing by for any nearby response calls from surrounding businesses.
While on standby, noticed two suspicious male individuals go inside JB Hi-Fi; continuing standby.
The male individuals have departed the store, no issues to report; leaving standby area.
Arrived at Fort Street check-in; commencing a full sweep down to Gore Street along with welfare checks on stores.
Arrived at Gore Street; welfare check on stores along Fort Street, Commerce Street and Gore Street, all clear, no issues reported.
Arrived at Galway Street check-in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at TK Square; welfare check on stores within the area.
Welfare check on stores within the TK Square area, all clear, no issues. Heavy foot traffic at TK Square; standing by for security presence for members of the public and surrounding businesses.
While on standby, a female kicked a male she was with, then walked away; standing by in case she attempts anything further against members of the public.

Response call from Cotton On regarding a female and male couple who stole jewellery from their store, last seen heading up Queen Street. Descriptions — female: pink t-shirt, backpack; male: white t-shirt, bald head, carrying a Countdown bag. Leaving TK Square to search for the POIs.
Arrived at the top of Queen Street; no sign of the POIs from Cotton On.

Arrived at Cotton On Queen Street to retrieve footage or photos of the POIs, but due to store policy it must be cleared with the manager before release, so no footage will be received today. Maintaining presence on Queen Street.
Arrived at HQ for a 10-minute break.
Floor checks complete; gearing up for patrols.
Arrived at the top of Victoria Street West; welfare check on stores along Victoria Street West, all clear, no issues reported. Standing by for security presence for surrounding businesses.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street requesting assistance to remove a vagrant from their premises.

Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street; the manager pointed out the vagrant. Informed him he had to leave and issued him a verbal trespass from the premises; he complied and walked away. Standing by in case he returns.
Arrived at HQ to charge the Ops Phone due to low percentage (percentage displayed on the kitchen camera).
Response call from 77 Convenience Store on the corner of Hobson Street and Victoria Street West requesting assistance to move along two vagrants sitting outside their store.

Arrived at 77 Convenience Store Victoria Street West / Hobson Street; advised the two vagrants they had to move along at staff request. They were compliant; standing by while they gathered their belongings.
Vagrants have moved along successfully; heading back to HQ to continue charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage.
Arrived at HQ; charging the Ops Phone (percentage displayed on the office camera).
Ops Phone at 43%, enough to patrol until end of shift (percentage displayed on the office camera).
Arrived at the bottom of Wyndham Street; welfare check at QF Tavern and Ibis Budget Hotel, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at TK Square; welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Gore Street check-in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Commerce Street check-in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Fort Street check-in, all clear, no issues. Standing by for any nearby response calls and on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Departing standby area; no issues occurred.
Arrived at Chancery Square / Freyberg Square check-in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Lorne Street check-in; commencing a full sweep down to Auckland Library along with welfare checks on stores.
Arrived at Auckland Library; full sweep complete, no issues, and welfare check on stores all clear, nothing to report.
Arrived at Munster Inn check-in, all clear, no issues; standing by for any assistance that may be needed.
Received a call from Hasi to head down to TK Square for security presence.
Arrived at TK Square; standing by.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: No equipment list recorded in the Night Shift log for this date.

Received a call from the manager to maintain consistent routine checks at Commercial Bay to assist the other guards there looking after equipment. Continued foot patrol from upper Queen Street towards Commercial Bay; no issues to report.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; assisted the guards there looking after the equipment. No issues so far.

While standing guard at Commercial Bay, an accident occurred at the T-section between Customs Street and Queen Street — a woman riding a scooter was hit by an Uber car. Went over to assist; she could not move. Police and paramedics arrived, so we handed over responsibility and moved on from the scene. (Footage on file.)
Commenced foot patrol towards the Viaduct area; a lot of people out tonight, no issues to report.
Welfare check at Danny Doolans; not particularly busy, no issues from the team or the bar manager there, and no issues from the surrounding bars.
Commenced foot patrol along Albert Street and towards Aotea Square; no issues encountered, all side streets quiet.
Arrived at Fort Street; all businesses locked, no issues to report.
No issues along Fort Lane; the night is getting quiet.
Went through Gore Street and up to High Street, no issues to report; streets are quiet.
Received a call from McDonald's Queen Street about a homeless man disturbing customers inside the venue; responded straight away.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street and removed the homeless man; he complied and moved on with no issues.
Continued patrol along Queen Street towards Commercial Bay; no issues along the way.
Arrived back at Commercial Bay; no issues from the guards looking after the equipment. Stayed to assist guarding the equipment; no issues so far.
Commenced foot patrol along Quay Street and back up to upper Queen Street; no issues along the way, no damage or breaches to report.
Commenced foot patrol along Kitchener Street towards Commercial Bay; no issues so far.
Arrived at Commercial Bay to assist the guards looking after the equipment; no issues so far.
Heading back to the office to sign off and collect personal belongings; no issues along the way.
Arrived at HQ and handed over to the morning patrol team; shift concluded.

flags: SENSITIVE: 23:00 Serious vehicle accident at Customs/Queen Street T-section — scooter rider hit by an Uber car, unable to move; team assisted until Police and paramedics took over. Footage on file.
MISSING SHIFT: Night Shift log has no equipment list recorded (log kept in a different bulleted format; shift coverage itself is complete).
STALE: 16:43 Afternoon log records a female kicking a male companion at TK Square with no further action or outcome logged beyond standby.
